Usage:
  cdidx db integrity|--integrity-check [--db <path>] [--json]
  cdidx db schema [--type <table|index|trigger|view>] [--name <object>] [--limit <n<=200>] [--max-sql-chars <n<=8192>] [--summary-only] [--include-internal|--exclude-internal] [--db <path>] [--json]
  cdidx db prune --dry-run|--apply [--db <path>] [--json]
  cdidx db checkpoint [name<=128] [--dry-run] [--db <path>] [--json]

  cdidx db restore <name<=128> [--db <path>] [--json]
  cdidx db restore-backups --list|--prune [--keep <n>] [--db <path>] [--json]

Notes:
  schema defaults to the full sqlite_master dump for support bundles; use --summary-only, --limit, --max-sql-chars, and --exclude-internal for bounded diagnostics.
  checkpoint --dry-run reports the DB/WAL/SHM files and byte count without creating the checkpoint directory.
  checkpoint creates a filesystem snapshot next to the DB; restore replaces the DB and keeps a pre-restore backup directory.
  prune --dry-run only counts orphan rows; prune --apply deletes them and may run WAL checkpoint maintenance.

Run `cdidx --help` to show all commands and shared options.
